name: pi-governance-pipeline
description: Turns a PRD into project governance (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, SYSTEM.md, MEMORY.md) and turns that governance into an issue-driven auto-develop pipeline with per-role model routing, independent multi-model review, severity-based gating, and hard run budgets.
